subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu upgrades retain the shipped automatic-card and `markdown.tableMode` behavior, or should native `tag:md` become the new default carrier despite changing those existing settings?
rationale: Both implementations are technically viable, but source and platform documentation cannot decide whether existing user configuration and carrier semantics may be reinterpreted during upgrade.

options.title: Preserve compatibility first
options.body: Keep automatic card routing and table conversion by default, expose native posts through an existing explicit mode, and reconsider defaults after upgrade evidence.

options.title: Approve native-post default
options.body: Intentionally redefine automatic routing and table behavior, with explicit release guidance and proof covering fresh installs, upgrades, streaming, edits, and proactive sends.

options.title: Split inbound only
options.body: Land the independent `content_v2` parsing work after focused proof and defer the outbound carrier change to a dedicated proposal.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility first
recommendation.body: Keep automatic card routing and table conversion by default, expose native posts through an existing explicit mode, and reconsider defaults after upgrade evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows the closest ownership of Feishu reply dispatch and streaming-card behavior affected by this choice.
